contentEn:
How much does a home renovation cost in Langley, Walnut Grove and Fort Langley in 2026? This guide covers real prices from 58 completed Reno Stars projects across Murrayville, Walnut Grove, and Fort Langley — kitchen, bathroom, basement, and whole-house renovation costs with Township of Langley permit requirements. Renovation costs in Langley, Walnut Grove and Fort Langley in 2026 reflect the Township's unique character: a mix of suburban lots, agricultural land, and urban centres like Willowbrook. Unlike Vancouver proper, Langley offers more space and — in many cases — more affordable access to licensed contractors. This guide gives you the real numbers so you can budget accurately before signing a contract.

What does a kitchen renovation cost in Langley?

Kitchen renovation costs in Langley in 2026 range from $20,000 to $75,000+ depending on scope and neighbourhood. A basic kitchen update — refacing cabinet doors, new hardware, laminate countertop, and paint — starts at $15,000–$22,000. A mid-range renovation with semi-custom shaker cabinets, quartz countertops, subway tile backsplash, and updated lighting typically runs $30,000–$55,000. A premium renovation with full custom cabinetry, natural stone countertops, premium appliances, and structural changes (removing a non-load-bearing wall to open the layout) can reach $60,000–$90,000 or higher. Walnut Grove homes tend to have larger kitchens than Murrayville — a larger footprint means more cabinets and countertops, pushing mid-range costs to $38,000–$58,000. Homes in Fort Langley — many built before 1960 — may require structural assessment and knob-and-tube wiring remediation before a kitchen renovation can begin.

What does a bathroom renovation cost in Langley?

Bathroom renovation costs in Langley in 2026 start at $12,000 for a cosmetic refresh and reach $55,000 for a full primary bathroom with premium finishes. A cosmetic refresh — new vanity, toilet, fixture updates, and fresh paint — runs $12,000–$18,000. A mid-range bathroom renovation with new tile shower, custom vanity, quartz countertop, and quality fixtures typically costs $20,000–$35,000. A premium master bathroom with curbless walk-in shower, heated floors, frameless glass, and high-end fixtures ranges $38,000–$55,000. Luxury master ensuites with steam systems and custom tile work can exceed $70,000. Fort Langley heritage bathrooms — often small and historically configured — sometimes require a complete re-layout that adds $5,000–$12,000 to the project compared to a standard mid-range renovation.

Whole-house renovation cost in Langley

Whole-house renovation costs in Langley vary significantly by neighbourhood and project scope. Murrayville and Brookswood homes — among Langley's more affordable neighbourhoods — see mid-range whole-house renovations from $150,000 to $300,000. Walnut Grove homes with larger footprints and more rooms typically range $200,000 to $500,000 for a comprehensive renovation including kitchen, bathrooms, flooring, and exterior updates. Premium whole-house renovations in Langley exceed $500,000. A whole-house renovation in Langley typically takes 4–9 months of active construction. Permit processing adds 2–4 weeks on top of that timeline.

Basement renovation and legal suite costs in Langley

Basement renovation costs in Langley start at $50,000 for a basic recreation room with one additional bedroom. Finishing a basement to a legal suite standard — required for any secondary rental unit in Langley under BC's housing regulations — adds $15,000–$25,000 for a separate entrance, kitchen rough-in, and fire separation to meet BC Building Code. A legal basement suite renovation in Langley costs $65,000–$95,000 as a full conversion. Converting an already-finished basement to legal suite standard (adding the required fire-rated wall, separate entrance, and kitchen) typically runs $45,000–$65,000.

Langley renovation cost comparison by neighbourhood

The table below shows typical renovation cost ranges by neighbourhood in Langley. Figures include materials, labour, and permit-related fees.
Renovation typeMurrayville / BrookswoodWalnut GroveFort Langley
Kitchen (mid-range)$30,000–$52,000$38,000–$58,000$35,000–$55,000
Bathroom (mid-range)$20,000–$32,000$22,000–$35,000$25,000–$40,000
Whole-house renovation$150,000–$300,000$200,000–$500,000$180,000–$400,000
Basement (legal suite)$65,000–$90,000$70,000–$95,000$75,000–$100,000
These are all-in figures for labour, materials, and permit fees. They do not include furniture, appliances purchased separately, or work done by the homeowner.

Township of Langley permit requirements

The Township of Langley requires a building permit for any renovation valued at $5,000 or more. Electrical work requires a separate electrical permit; plumbing changes require a plumbing permit. Townhouse and strata renovations require strata council approval before a building permit can be submitted. Township of Langley building permit fees are based on construction value. For a typical kitchen renovation ($30,000–$55,000), permit fees range from $1,200 to $2,200. A basement suite conversion ($65,000–$95,000) attracts permit fees of $1,800–$3,000 plus additional plumbing permit fees of $350–$600. Standard renovation permits in Langley typically process in 2–4 weeks. Basement suite permits and structural permits take 4–8 weeks. Heritage alteration permits (required in Fort Langley for exterior changes to designated heritage properties) add an additional 4–8 weeks.

Renovation timeline in Langley

A kitchen renovation in Langley typically takes 3–5 weeks of active construction. A mid-range bathroom renovation runs 2–3 weeks. A whole-house renovation — from permit application to handover — typically spans 4–9 months. Basement renovations run 6–14 weeks for a basic finish, 10–16 weeks for a legal suite conversion.

Why Langley renovation costs differ from Vancouver

Langley renovation costs typically run 5–10% below comparable work in Vancouver proper. The main reasons: lower commercial rent for contractor offices and showrooms, less traffic and travel time between job sites, and a less competitive bidding environment for licensed contractors. In Walnut Grove — Langley's most densely populated neighbourhood — larger homes mean larger renovation scopes, which narrows the cost gap with Vancouver. A whole-house renovation in Walnut Grove ($200,000–$500,000) can overlap with equivalent work in mid-range Vancouver neighbourhoods.

How to budget for your Langley renovation in 2026

Start with the ranges in the table above. Then add 10–15% for unforeseen conditions — especially in Fort Langley homes built before 1970, where knob-and-tube wiring, old cast-iron plumbing, and asbestos in plaster are commonly encountered. Before signing a contract, confirm your contractor carries $5M commercial general liability insurance and active WorkSafeBC coverage. Ask for a written quote that itemises labour and materials separately, and confirm it includes permit fees. Avoid any contractor who asks for more than 30% upfront. Planning a kitchen, bathroom, whole-house, or basement suite renovation in Langley? Get a free, no-obligation quote from Reno Stars. Estimates include an on-site assessment and a written breakdown by scope.

How is renovating in Murrayville different from Walnut Grove?

Murrayville is Langley's oldest neighbourhood, with many homes built between 1950 and 1975. Brookswood and Fern Ridge are newer, developed primarily in the 1970s and 1980s. Walnut Grove was developed later, with most homes built between 1985 and 2005. The age of the housing stock affects renovation cost primarily through preconditions: older Murrayville homes may require knob-and-tube wiring remediation ($3,000–$8,000), asbestos abatement if built before 1990 ($2,000–$10,000), and cast-iron pipe replacement ($2,000–$6,000). Walnut Grove homes generally require fewer preconditions, which can make their per-project costs lower despite larger average footprints.

What about heritage home renovations in Fort Langley?

Fort Langley is a designated heritage conservation area. Exterior changes to listed heritage properties require a Heritage Alteration Permit (HAP) from the Township of Langley in addition to a standard building permit. HAPs add 4–8 weeks to permit processing and may require heritage consultant involvement ($1,500–$3,000). Interior renovations in Fort Langley heritage homes do not require a HAP. Fort Langley homes — many built before 1960 — frequently require knob-and-tube wiring assessment and remediation before any electrical permit can be issued. Budget an additional $3,000–$8,000 for preconditions if your Fort Langley home was built before 1970.

How long does a Township of Langley building permit take?

Standard renovation permits in Langley (kitchen, bathroom, basement finish) typically take 2–4 weeks to process after a complete application is submitted. Basement suite permits and structural permits (load-bearing wall removal, beam installation) take 4–8 weeks. Heritage Alteration Permits add 4–8 weeks on top of the standard process. If your renovation requires both a building permit and a heritage alteration permit, plan for a combined lead time of 8–16 weeks before construction can begin. Reno Stars prepares and submits complete permit applications as part of every contract — you do not need to manage this yourself.

Should I hire a Langley contractor or a Vancouver contractor for my Langley renovation?

A Langley-based contractor typically has lower overhead and may offer a lower price for equivalent work. Vancouver-based contractors who regularly work in Langley often have more experience with complex projects but charge a premium for travel time and job-site logistics. Reno Stars is based in Richmond, directly across the Alex Fraser Bridge from Langley — our crews have managed renovation projects in Langley since 2020 and are familiar with Township of Langley permit requirements, inspectors, and scheduling. For most Langley renovations, a contractor with direct Langley experience offers the best balance of cost and local knowledge.

2026年蘭里、沃爾核桃林及匹茲堡住宅裝修費用是多少？本文涵蓋聚星裝修在穆雷維爾、沃爾核桃林及匹茲堡完成的58個項目中的真實價格——包括廚房、衛浴、地下室及全屋裝修費用，以及蘭里鎮的建築許可證要求。 蘭里、沃爾核桃林和匹茲堡的裝修費用反映了該鎮獨有的特徵：郊區地塊、農業用地和威洛普brook等城市中心的混合。與溫哥華本市不同，蘭里提供更多空間，在許多情況下更能接觸持牌承包商。本文提供真實數據，幫助您在簽約前準確預算。

蘭里廚房裝修費用是多少？

蘭里廚房裝修費用在2026年從 $20,000 到 $75,000 不等，具體取決於工程範圍和社區。 基本廚房更新——更新櫥櫃門、新硬件、層壓檯面和油漆——起價 $15,000–$22,000。中檔裝修配備鄉村風格櫥櫃、石英石檯面、地鐵瓷磚擋板和更新照明，通常運行 $30,000–$55,000。配備全定制櫥櫃、天然石材檯面、優質電器和結構變更（拆除非承重牆以開放格局）的高檔裝修可達 $60,000–$90,000 或更高。 沃爾核桃林住宅往往比穆雷維爾的更大——更大的佔地面積意味著更多的櫥櫃和檯面，將中檔成本推高至 $38,000–$58,000。匹茲堡的許多房屋建於1960年之前——可能需要在開始廚房裝修前進行結構評估和布線修復。

蘭里浴室裝修費用是多少？

蘭里浴室裝修費用在2026年從 $12,000 的化妝品刷新到 $55,000 的全主浴室不等。 化妝品刷新——新洗手台、馬桶、固定裝置更新和新鮮油漆——運行 $12,000–$18,000。配備瓷磚淋浴、定制洗手台、石英石檯面和優質固定裝置的中檔浴室裝修通常花費 $20,000–$35,000。配備步入式淋浴間、地暖、無框玻璃和高檔固定裝置的豪華主浴室範圍為 $38,000–$55,000。帶蒸汽系統和定制瓷磚工程的豪華主浴室可超過 $70,000。 匹茲堡傳統浴室——通常較小且歷史配置——有時需要完全重新佈局，與標準中檔裝修相比，額外增加 $5,000–$12,000。

蘭里全屋裝修費用

蘭里全屋裝修費用因社區和工程範圍而差異很大。 穆雷維爾和布魯克斯伍德房屋——蘭里較實惠的社區之一——全屋中檔裝修從 $150,000 到 $300,000 不等。沃爾核桃林的較大佔地面積和更多房間的房屋通常在 $200,000 到 $500,000 之間，用於包括廚房、浴室、地板和外觀更新的全面裝修。蘭里的豪華全屋裝修超過 $500,000。 蘭里的全屋裝修通常需要4-9個月的積極建設。許可證處理額外增加2-4週。

蘭里地下室裝修和合法套房費用

蘭里地下室裝修費用從帶一間額外臥室的基本娛樂室開始，起價 $50,000。將地下室裝修到合法套房標準——根據BC省的住房法規在蘭里所需——增加 $15,000–$25,000，內容包括獨立入口、廚房粗裝修和防火隔離，以符合BC建築規範。 蘭里合法地下室套房裝修作為完整轉換，費用為 $65,000–$95,000。將已完成裝修的地下室轉換為合法套房標準（增加所需的防火牆、獨立入口和廚房）通常運行 $45,000–$65,000。

蘭里裝修費用，按社區比較

下表顯示蘭里各社區的典型裝修費用範圍。數字包括材料、人工和許可相關費用。
裝修類型穆雷維爾 / 布魯克斯伍德沃爾核桃林匹茲堡
廚房（中檔）$30,000–$52,000$38,000–$58,000$35,000–$55,000
浴室（中檔）$20,000–$32,000$22,000–$35,000$25,000–$40,000
全屋裝修$150,000–$300,000$200,000–$500,000$180,000–$400,000
地下室（合法套房）$65,000–$90,000$70,000–$95,000$75,000–$100,000
這些是人工、材料和許可費用的全包數字。它們不包括單獨購買的家具、電器或業主自行完成的工程。

蘭里鎮許可證要求

蘭里鎮要求對價值 $5,000 或以上的任何裝修持有建築許可證。 electrical工程需要單獨的電氣許可證；管道變更需要管道許可證。聯排別墅和共管裝修需要在提交建築許可證之前獲得共管委員會批准。 蘭里鎮建築許可證費用根據建築價值計算。對於典型廚房裝修（$30,000–$55,000），許可證費用從 $1,200 到 $2,200 不等。地下室套房裝修（$65,000–$95,000）的許可證費用為 $1,800–$3,000，加上額外管道許可證費用 $350–$600。 蘭里標準裝修許可證通常在2-4週內處理。地下室套房許可證和結構許可證需要4-8週。遺產變更許可證（在匹茲堡對指定遺產房產的外觀變更所需）額外增加4-8週。

蘭里裝修時間線

蘭里廚房裝修通常需要3-5週的積極施工。中檔浴室裝修需要2-3週。全屋裝修——從許可證申請到移交——通常跨越4-9個月。地下室裝修對於基本飾面需要6-14週，對於合法套房轉換需要10-16週。

為什麼蘭里裝修費用與溫哥華不同？

蘭里裝修費用通常比溫哥華本市的類似工程低5–10%。主要原因：承包商辦公室和陳列室的商業租金較低，工地之間的交通和出行時間較少，持牌承包商的競爭投標環境較不激烈。 在沃爾核桃林——蘭里人口最多的社區——更大的房屋意味著更大的裝修範圍，這縮小了與溫哥華的成本差距。沃爾核桃林的全屋裝修（$200,000–$500,000）可能與溫哥華中檔社區的同等工程重疊。

如何為2026年的蘭里裝修編制預算

從上表中的範圍開始。然後增加10-15%以應對意外情況——尤其是在1970年之前建造的匹茲堡房屋中，那裡通常會遇到布線、舊鑄鐵管道和灰泥中的石棉。 在簽約前，確認您的承包商持有 $5M 商業責任險和活躍的 WorkSafeBC 保險。要求提供書面報價，分別列明人工和材料，並確認其包括許可證費用。避免要求預付款超過30%的承包商。 在蘭里規劃廚房、浴室、全屋或地下室套房裝修？獲取聚星裝修的免費、無義務報價。估計包括現場評估和按範圍細分的書面明細。

穆雷維爾和沃爾核桃林的裝修有什麼不同？

穆雷維爾是蘭里最古老的社區，許多房屋建於1950年至1975年之間。布魯克斯伍德和fern山脊較新，主要在1970年代和1980年代開發。沃爾核桃林開發較晚，大部分房屋建於1985年至2005年之間。房屋庫存年齡主要通過預防條件影響裝修成本：較老的穆雷維爾房屋可能需要布線修復（$3,000–$8,000）、1990年前建造的房屋需要石棉處理（$2,000–$10,000），以及鑄鐵管道更換（$2,000–$6,000）。沃爾核桃林房屋通常需要更少的預防條件，這可能使他們的每項目成本較低，儘管平均佔地面積更大。

匹茲堡傳統住宅裝修怎麼樣？

匹茲堡是指定的遺產保護區。 listed遺產房產的外觀變更需要蘭里鎮的遺產變更許可證（HAP），以及標準建築許可證。HAP使許可證處理時間增加4-8週，並可能需要遺產顧問參與（$1,500–$3,000）。匹茲堡遺產住宅的室內裝修不需要HAP。匹茲堡的許多房屋建於1960年之前——在發布任何電氣許可證之前，通常需要進行布線評估和修復。如果您的匹茲堡房屋建於1970年之前，請為預防條件預算額外的 $3,000–$8,000。

蘭里鎮建築許可證需要多長時間？

蘭里標準裝修許可證（廚房、浴室、地下室飾面）通常在完整申請提交後2-4週內處理。地下室套房許可證和結構許可證（承重牆拆除、樑安裝）需要4-8週。遺產變更許可證在標準流程基礎上增加4-8週。如果您的裝修同時需要建築許可證和遺產變更許可證，請為施工開始前的 combined準備時間計劃8-16週。聚星裝修作為每份合約的一部分準備並提交完整的許可證申請——您不需要自己管理這一切。

我應該為蘭里裝修聘請蘭里承包商還是溫哥華承包商？

總部位於蘭里的承包商通常具有較低的 overhead，可能以同等工程提供較低的價格。經常在蘭里工作的溫哥華承包商通常在複雜項目方面有更多經驗，但會為出行時間和工地物流收取溢價。聚星裝修總部位於列治文，位於連接蘭里的亞lex弗雷澤大橋對面——我們的團隊自2020年以來一直在蘭里管理裝修項目，熟悉蘭里鎮的許可證要求、檢查員和調度。對於大多數蘭里裝修，具有直接蘭里經驗的承包商提供最佳的成本和當地知識平衡。
